label: Default
description: Canonical profile: TASK.md holds the brief and the built-in task observer keeps the status.

progress.notes: The task observer reports progress; manual reports use --message.

templates.dispatchSummary: The target session was instructed to do the work; the task observer reports status. Follow it with:
templates.dispatchEventMessage: Dispatched to {{session.agentId}}/{{session.name}}. The worker reads the brief at {{task.taskDocPath}}; the task observer reports status.

label: Observed Task
description: Alias of default kept for existing callers: TASK.md brief plus the built-in task observer.

progress.notes: The built-in task observer reports progress.

templates.dispatchSummary: The target session was instructed to do the work; the task observer reports status. Follow it with:
templates.dispatchEventMessage: Dispatched observed task to {{session.agentId}}/{{session.name}}. The worker reads the brief at {{task.taskDocPath}}; the task observer reports status.
